summary.text: Matt Brass, a Republican, was first elected to the Georgia State Senate in November 2016 and represents Senate District 6; he chairs the Senate Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: He was raised in Newnan, served in the U.S. Navy, and graduated from the University of Georgia.
He worked seven years as a golf club professional and then as a field representative and chief of staff for Congressman Lynn Westmoreland, and is a partner at Lott Metal & Commercial Roofing.
